title: Build Buddy
tagline: Run the route. Build the way.
description: A momentum platformer where you switch between running the route and placing platforms, springs, and checkpoints to build it. Solo local play (switch roles solo) and Practice/Debug Lab are playable now; true two-player co-op (one runner, one builder) works in Online mode via public matchmaking or private room codes.
status: Playable - solo local run + practice, plus online 2P co-op, across a 10-stage pack
